author: AdamChen
body: I know this isn't directly towards admins, but I think they most likely have a say in how tourney staff should be doing things. My team PureDogs has yet to be contacted whatsoever about the prize pool, and whenever I've tried to ask a tourney staff member about the prize pool, I get a very vague answer. It'd be nice if we could actually receive the prize, ya know?
